infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GymLink uses your photo library so you can add photos and videos to your recipes and profile.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GymLink uses your camera so you can take profile photos and record workout videos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: GymLink uses your microphone to record video sound when filming workout videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: GymLink saves photos and videos to your library.

plugins.microphonePermission: GymLink needs microphone access to record videos for recipes.
